title: Console About dialog shows only the console build sha, never the ObjectStack version the runtime reports
body:
triage#1 · baozhoutao · session_01RKKVnjDWRBLyPJGFTCoQrC

## What happens

Help menu → About opens the "About this console" dialog (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AboutDialog.tsx`). Its single row, "Console build", shows a git short sha such as `b914e724`. Nowhere does the dialog give the ObjectStack version.

Observed on a production deployment:

- the dialog shows `b914e724` (that commit is `chore: version packages (#33097)`)
- `GET /api/v1/discovery` returns `"version": "18.5.0"`
- `GET /api/v1/health` also returns `"version": "18.5.0"`

People open About to find the version number. A bare commit sha does not answer that for an end user or an admin. It also does not match the Version field in our own issue templates, which asks for "the build shown under About in the Console's help menu" when the useful value there is the release.

## Why

`AboutDialog.tsx`'s module doc says the runtime's version is left out on purpose because "the shell has no request that reads it today". The discovery document already carries `version`, resolved by `resolveDiscoveryVersion()` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/discovery-version.ts`. That makes the stated reason out of date.

## Expected

- Add an **ObjectStack version** row to the dialog, filled from the discovery `version` (`18.5.0` above). Put it first.
- Keep **Console build** (the sha from `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts`'s `VITE_APP_VERSION` / `git rev-parse --short HEAD`) as a second, clearly labelled row so a deployment can still be traced to a commit.
- If discovery is unavailable or returns no version, say so in words, the same way the existing "unknown build" fallback does. Never leave the field empty.
- Add i18n keys for the new row (en + zh-Hans at minimum).
- Update the pin test `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970.test.tsx`, or add a sibling test.

Lane: `domain:ui`.
